### What Real Estate Cash Rebate Does
Real Estate Cash Rebate matches Canadians who are buying or selling a home with the best, most experienced, vetted real estate agents in their market, and pays an eligible client a real estate cashback rebate at closing. The agent quality comes first; the cashback is added value on top, never a discount in disguise. The guiding promise: you don't settle for less to save money.

### How the Real Estate Cashback Rebate Works
1. Call before you list or start your search. That first call is what makes the rebate possible.
2. We match you with one of the most experienced, proven agents in your market, an agent we have personally vetted.
3. When your sale or purchase closes, a referral reward is shared with us, and we pass a portion back to you, in writing, as your real estate cashback rebate.
Eligible clients receive up to $2.50 for every $1,000 of the home's sale or purchase price, based on a 5% commission. The exact rebate is confirmed in writing before you begin. The service is free to you.

### Positioning
- Lead with the best vetted agents. Cash back is the bonus, not the hook.
- This is the opposite of a discount brokerage. You never trade down to a lesser agent to save money.
- Commissions are negotiable and transparent. No one inflates the commission to fund a rebate.
- We are not tied to any single brokerage or franchise, so we match you with the right local agent.
- We do not accept payment from agents to be on our list. We work only with agents we believe are the best in each region.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

**Is a real estate cashback rebate legal in Canada?**
Yes. Returning part of a real estate commission to the buyer or seller is legal across Canada when it is documented in writing. It is overseen province by province (for example, RECO under TRESA in Ontario). Referral rewards can only flow between registered brokerages, which is why rebates are provided through RSG Real Estate Inc.

**How much will I get back?**
Eligible clients receive up to $2.50 for every $1,000 of the home's sale or purchase price, based on a 5% commission. The exact rebate is confirmed in writing before you begin.

**Is this a discount brokerage?**
No, it is the opposite. You get a top-performing, proven agent and full professional service, plus a real estate cashback rebate on top.

**Does it cost anything?**
No. The service is free to you, and the rebate is money back in your pocket.

**Do I have to call before I hire an agent?**
Yes. The rebate depends on us making the introduction, so the earlier you call the better. We never solicit clients who are already under contract.
